'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[cipher clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

Players must have completed [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]] to complete the step; the version of the Fairy Queen in Zanaris '''will not work'''. Players can reach the hideout by using the [[Fairy rings]] in this sequence:

# '''air''' (to a small island)
# '''dlr''' (to another small island)
# '''djq''' (to nowhere)
# '''ajs''' (to the hideout)
